toolsPreview.name: get_network_health
toolsPreview.description: Returns a 0-100 Solana network health score combining slot time, delinquent stake, prioritization fees, and skipped slot rate — plus the raw metrics behind it. Useful before executing a timing-sensitive transaction. Paid: $0.002 per call via x402.

toolsPreview.name: get_recommended_priority_fee
toolsPreview.description: Recommends a Solana transaction priority fee (in micro-lamports per compute unit) based on recent network activity, at low/medium/high confidence levels. Paid: $0.002 per call via x402.
